findings.summary: The schema-v2 live/graph validator is not migration-compatible with the authoritative schema-v1 evidence already on PR #1. REVIEW-05's live comment contains fenced Gate Record JSON without Gate-Record-Commit, so parse_visible_declarations always reports it invalid; validate_graph also ignores REVIEW-06's legacy supersedes edge, leaving REVIEW-05 active alongside a current review. Complete-ledger validation therefore cannot pass without mutating history. Preserve old comments and records, add an append-only migration declaration or rigorously bind legacy JSON to its unique canonical remote object, honor validated legacy supersession in active-record calculation, and add real mixed-version regression fixtures.
